'''Damaris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]] and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] at various times.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Damaris appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], where he was originally the Quesh Modification Commendations vendor on Vaiken Spacedock and Quesh. He was later relabeled as the Level 34 Modification Vendor, and with the release of Game Update 4.0 he now appears on a number of other planets.<ref name="TOR" />
